A '''droid''' was the [[bartender]] at a [[unidentified cantina (Lau)|cantina]] on the [[planet]] [[Lau]]<ref name="ADA" /> during or after [[18 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|304}}</ref>

The droid had an understanding with the resident [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[captain]], [[Mann]], serving him his regular drink when he approached the bar and telling him about the establishment's happenings.<ref name="ADA" />
